picks.what: View over Sachsenhausen to the city and the Taunus, painting (Städel Museum)

notes: Excluded Frankfurt (Oder) hits (#3, #8, #10, #38). Mittelholzer film is filed under October 1935 but ETH notes it is probably misfiled; the same film shows the Rhein-Main airport being cleared (opened 1936), so about 1935 holds. Merian panorama dated about 1617–18 on Commons.
